questions.question: Given below are four words out of which three are alike in a certain context and one of them is inconsistent. Select that inconsistent word.
questions.solution:

**Option (****3) Hypertension ****→ It is not a disease of bone.**

Hence, **“****Hypertension****”** is an odd one.

questions.question: The total of three numbers is 240. The second number is four times the first number. The third number is three times the first number. What will be the average of the three numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers is x, y and z.

Given :-

The total of three numbers is 240

So, x + y + z = 240 → eq. (i)

The second number is four times the first number.

y = 4x

The third number is three times the first number.

z = 3x

Put the value of y and z in eq. (i)

x + 4x + 3x = 240

8x = 240

x = 30

So,

Second number is y = 4x = 4 × 30 = 120

Third number is z = 3x = 3 × 30 = 90

Average of numbers = Sum of total number &d

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(7, 9, 252)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

(First Number × second number) × 4 = Third Number

**In (7, 9, 252)**

(First Number × second number) × 4

= (7 × 9) × 4

= 63 × 4

= 252 = Third Number

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) (6, 9, 188)**

(First Number × second number) × 4

= (6 × 9) × 4

= 54 × 4

= 216 ≠ Third Number

**Option (2) (12, 10, 260)**

(First Number × second number) × 4

= (12 × 10) × 4

= 120 × 4

= 480 ≠ Third Number

**Option (3) (8, 11, 352)**

(First Number × second number) × 4

**= (8 × 11) × 4**

**= 88 × 4**

**= 352 = Third Number**

**Option (4) (6, 8, 212)**

(First Number × second number) × 4

= (6 × 8) × 4

= 48 × 4

= 192 ≠ Third Number

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(8, 11, 352)****".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**The pattern followed here is:

**(1st number + 2nd number)² - (1st number - 2nd number)² = 3rd number**

(7, 9, 252) → (7 + 9)² - (7 - 9)² = 256 - 4 = 252

Similarly, 

**Option 3) (8, 11, 352)**

**(8 + 11)² - (8 - 11)² = 361 - 9 = 352**

Hence, the correct answer is "(8, 11, 352)".
